ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; dominant low-intensity black pixels (approx 85%) versus high-intensity white pixels (approx 15%) concentrated in the inferior right lobe and the extreme distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white mottled region localized on the distal-inferior quadrant of the right lobe. High-intensity focal spots are mapped to the terminal points of both lobes. The remainder of the fluke surface is characterized by a relatively uniform low-intensity black mapping with sparse white punctate spots.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped central depression with an estimated interior pixel angle of 60-70 degrees and a vertical depth relative to the lobe span of approximately 12%.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations detected along the entire trailing boundary. Pixel-amplitude variations are most pronounced on the outer thirds of the lobes, featuring sharp peaks and deep narrow valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex sweep on the leading edges meeting at acute distal tips; trailing edges exhibit a sigmoid curve transitioning from concave near the median notch to convex near the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-intensity circular pixel groups at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization scars. Isolated high-intensity circular spots are sparsely distributed across the dark field of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertically-oriented linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible on the mid-section of the left lobe, appearing as mid-intensity grey streaks against the black surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white scarring or pigmentation patch on the lower half of the right lobe; jagged, irregular erosion of the trailing edge margins particularly at the distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of small, low-intensity circular voids (dark pits) situated within the high-intensity white mottled patch on the right lobe.
